description: Speech clips for a guest session: list, capture, delete, playback.
precondition: Guest session in a meeting in progress.

preconditions: A current, named guest session of a standing invitation for an Online meeting in status InProgress.
The guest confirmed the recording notice; the speech worker is configured and free.
cases.inputs: guest session; meetingId; upload: clientClipId new, durationMs 5,000, audio/wav audio.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG318) with the saved sentence owned by the invitation (not a user).
cases.log: A ClipAdded change is published to the meeting.

preconditions: A current guest session, but the meeting ended 3 days ago (a member could still send).
cases.inputs: guest session; meetingId of the ended meeting; upload: valid.

preconditions: A current guest session with a confirmed notice.
cases.inputs: guest session; meetingId; upload: audio of 0 bytes.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG319) with an error on audio.

preconditions: A current guest session, but the guest never confirmed the recording notice.
cases.inputs: guest session without a confirmed notice; meetingId; upload: valid.

preconditions: The invitation is revoked after the capture check, before the sentence is stored.
cases.inputs: guest session admitted at check, revoked before the commit; upload: valid.
cases.return: NotCapturing (409, MSG320); the audio file written for the sentence is deleted.
